title: Season 1
overview: Agatha Harkness and an assembled coven navigate trials along the Witches' Road to reclaim their lost power.

episodes.title: Seekest Thou the Road
episodes.overview: Agatha breaks free of Wanda's Westview spell with help from a mysterious teen and sets out to gather a coven.

episodes.title: Circle Sewn with Fate / Unlock Thy Hidden Gate
episodes.overview: The newly assembled coven performs the Sacred Ballad to open the gateway to the Witches' Road.

episodes.title: Through Many Miles of Tricks and Trials
episodes.overview: The coven faces their first trial involving potioncraft and hidden family grief.

episodes.title: If I Can't Reach You Let My Song Teach You
episodes.overview: A 1970s rock trial challenges the coven to harmonize through curse protection.

episodes.title: Darkest Hour, Wake Thy Power
episodes.overview: Under a blood moon, high spirits bring buried secrets to light and the Salem Seven strike.

episodes.title: Familiar by Thy Side
episodes.overview: The true identity of the Teen is revealed through the story of William Kaplan and Billy Maximoff.

episodes.title: Death's Hand in Mine
episodes.overview: Lilia Calderu's non-linear life leads through a deadly tarot trial.

episodes.title: Follow Me My Friend To Glory at the End
episodes.overview: Agatha and Billy face the final trial of the Road and confrontation with Rio Vidal.

episodes.title: Maiden Mother Crone
episodes.overview: The true origins of the Witches' Road and Agatha's past with Nicholas Scratch are revealed.

verification.notes: Verified Agatha All Along Season 1 episode roster (9 episodes) matching Disney+ broadcast schedule.
